title: An audit table for several formulations
heading: The Solver's Own Work Decides Whether a Reformulation Solves Faster
cases: each formulation gets a line, in the order given, with its variables, rows and LP bound
the share of the gap closed is measured against the first formulation's gap: 0 for it, 1 for one whose LP bound is the optimum
the root bound is the solver's bound after one node, which can sit well below the LP bound
an inherited formulation whose LP bound is already the optimum has its gap reported as closed, 1.0
